composition: Two horizontal RGB/depth lanes run left to right into a shared prediction path. A separate dashed loss box sits below the lanes and is used only during training.

sources.s1: An RGB image and a depth image are processed by separate encoders.
sources.s2: The two feature vectors are concatenated and passed to a classifier to predict a class.
sources.s3: During training only, an alignment loss is computed from the two feature vectors. The alignment loss is not evaluated during inference.

zones.visual: Two independent horizontal lanes. Each contains an encoder block followed by a token strip.
zones.label: l_encoders

zones.visual: A central concatenation block followed by a classifier and class tile.
zones.label: l_predict

zones.visual: One centered loss block, with ample room on either side for dashed incoming connectors.

nodes.visual: A rectangular image glyph with three flat colored polygons; illustrative, not an experimental image.
nodes.label: l_rgb

nodes.visual: A rectangular tile divided into three flat gray bands; no depth values.
nodes.label: l_depth

nodes.visual: Three thin vertical plates followed by a wider rectangle; an encoder glyph.
nodes.label: l_re

nodes.visual: Three thin vertical plates followed by a wider rectangle; a separate encoder glyph.
nodes.label: l_de

nodes.visual: A row of four narrow rectangular tokens. The four glyphs do not assert a tensor dimension.
nodes.label: l_rf

nodes.visual: A row of four narrow rectangular tokens. The four glyphs do not assert a tensor dimension.
nodes.label: l_df

nodes.visual: Two token strips placed end to end inside the block. No plus sign.
nodes.label: l_concat

nodes.visual: Three small dots on the left linked to two dots on the right; a schematic classifier glyph.

nodes.visual: A small blank class tile with one dark circular marker; no scores.
nodes.label: l_class

nodes.visual: A rounded box with a dashed outline. Its label explicitly states the training-only phase.
nodes.label: l_loss
